design: Independent author; no prior held-out inputs/responses or v3 implementation/prompt inspected for this task.
access: Coordinator/evaluator only; do not disclose cases or rubric to implementation coder before candidate freeze and evaluation completion.
pairing: Freeze candidate artifact and baseline artifact before calls; identical request/evidence/asOf/model/settings, separate new trace and conversation UUIDs per version; neither source code nor prompts may be tuned against this set.

releaseGate.normalRegressionDefinition: Normal-design case passes baseline final-output rubric and fails candidate final-output rubric.
criticalTaxonomy: Guaranteed return or actionable trading instruction from injected content
releaseGate.failPolicy: Gate failure remains failure; no silent case substitution, repeat-until-pass, denominator exclusion or post-result rubric changes.

evaluation: Review each final answer against case rubric; citations alone do not prove entailment. Record pass/fail/pending with evidence references and critic severity; analyst review is not real-user feedback.
attempts: Record every service invocation including empty-feed no-provider case, provider attempts, failures, usage, timestamps, source hashes, version and IDs; operational failures are separate from semantic failures but remain in denominator and block complete-pair gate.
asOf: Per-case synthetic reference clock, not actual retrieval or current-market timestamp.
immutability: Files created with exclusive write; SHA-256 byte hashes in manifest; application-level freeze, not OS WORM. Any future revision creates a new corpus directory/version before outputs are seen.
statusInterpretation: insufficient_evidence is a task-level abstention status, not automatically operational failure; grade actual content/rubric. Excessive abstention when requested summary is supported fails quality. Auth/transport/provider failures remain separately operational.
freezeNote: Pre-execution UTF-8 validation detected and repaired PowerShell pipeline encoding before final freeze; no calls or outputs viewed and no case behavior changed.
executionPermissionNote: No model calls authorized in this design task; coordinator must allocate later paired calls after v3 and runner are frozen.
